evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from about 28,800 ppm to about 5-7 ppm, and it has held there through the growth stage
Temperature tracked the ramp setpoint closely; it overshot to 760.3 °C at the start of growth, then settled at 750 ±0.3 °C
Heater power is steady at about 45-46% during the hold, which fits a furnace at equilibrium
Pressure is steady at about 761.5 Torr, with no sign of a blockage or leak
Argon flow matches the 100 sccm setpoint

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample yet. No reference ranges from normal runs were given, so heater power can't be checked against typical values.
